annotations.text:
Leading option.
The burst comes out of the level number itself, so the thing that changed is the thing that moves. Nothing lands over the board, where you are still reading the next piece.
Level readout is 2.35rem on mobile (was 1.2rem) and 3.2rem on desktop (was 1.5rem), with a 2px rule under it in the level colour. Score keeps the orange hero slot.
Two other directions, each with its tradeoff written on the artboard. All three share the same colour ramp, so picking one does not change the level colours.
